experience.description: Builds and maintains the server side of three client products in Python (Django REST Framework) and PostgreSQL, with the largest handling 60,000 bookings a month. Integrated two local payment gateways and the national e-invoicing format, including retry and reconciliation jobs run by Celery workers on a Redis queue. Wrote pytest suites for billing rules (about 600 cases) after an invoicing fault reached a customer, with no billing regression since. Identified that the timetable page fired 400 queries per request, rewrote it with joins and prefetching, reducing response time from 3.2s to 280ms. Proposed and led the split of a shared 'core' app into separate billing and scheduling modules with clear boundaries, documented in a design note. Reviews merge requests from two junior developers and pairs with them weekly. On call one week in four, tracing production errors from Sentry traces and server logs back to the root cause.
